protocol.analysis: Preserve original results separately. Report all four raw arms, geometric per-round new/old ratios, disjoint newA/oldA and newB/oldB medians, oldB/oldA and newB/newA clone ratios, signs and process consistency. No baseline/clone subtraction, significance assertion, posthoc noise dismissal or automatic promotion/no-regression conclusion.
